summary_en: Lion Corporation authorized acquisition of up to 16.0 million shares (5.8% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of ¥20.0 billion through ToSTNeT-3 and open market purchases between November 9, 2026 and April 30, 2027, with all acquired shares to be cancelled to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition and Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 6, 2026, Lion Corporation's Board of Directors authorized the acquisition and immediate cancellation of up to 16.0 million shares of common stock, representing 5.8% of outstanding shares, for a maximum total price of ¥20.0 billion. The acquisition will be conducted from November 9, 2026 through April 30, 2027 using two methods: ToSTNeT-3 (off-market trading system) up to ¥10.0 billion, and open market purchases for any remaining amount up to the ¥20.0 billion ceiling.

The company stated that this action supports its medium-term business plan "Vision 2030 2nd STAGE," which emphasizes both disciplined growth investment and strengthened shareholder returns. The dual objectives are to enhance shareholder distributions and improve capital efficiency. All shares acquired under this authorization will be retired—those acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on November 19, 2026, and those acquired through market purchases by May 2027.

As of September 30, 2026, Lion had 276.7 million shares outstanding (excluding treasury stock) and held 3.1 million treasury shares, including 614,430 shares held through an employee equity trust. The acquisition price for the initial ToSTNeT-3 transaction was set at the closing price (or special after-hours quote) from November 6, with the precise amount to be announced after that day's trading close.
